value.rationale: The odd-eigenspace dimension of a Z2 grading, equivalently the rank of an idempotent derivation, is a natural invariant. The precise rank-by-rank counts and asymptotically positive nonsplit weight quantify how quadratic descent survives among all concrete gradings; this is not supplied by just naming the grading isomorphism types.
